game.title: Catherine
game.blurb: Puzzle-platformer and adventure game from Atlus and the Atlus Persona Team, published by SEGA, Atlus, Deep Silver and Capcom (as RAWG lists them), released 2011-02-17. RAWG average playtime: 4 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG, Puzzle. Chapters are an estimate drawn from the Steam achievements of Catherine Classic.

chapters.title: The Nightmare Stages
chapters.summary: Conquering Stage 1, then eight hidden achievements that follow it in the schema and fall in unlock rate (58.7% to 20.7%), most likely the later stages. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Endings and Completion
chapters.summary: Eight hidden achievements with low unlock rates, most likely the endings, plus viewing every ending and unlocking every other achievement. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Helping the Regulars
chapters.summary: Getting Justin, Todd, Archie, Daniel and Morgan out of their troubles, and helping everyone.

chapters.title: Nights at the Bar
chapters.summary: The jukebox, replying to text messages, the sake, beer, cocktail and whisky trivia, and staying until closing.

chapters.title: Golden Playhouse Block Tricks
chapters.summary: Pushing five blocks at once, sliding Ice Blocks, big explosions, Spring Block jumps and moving Dark Blocks.

chapters.title: Babel and the Colosseum
chapters.summary: Unlocking the Colosseum, unlocking and completing the Altar, Menhir and Obelisk stages of Babel with Gold Prizes, and three hidden achievements that follow them. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Rapunzel
chapters.summary: Beating Stage 64 of Rapunzel and two hidden achievements that follow it. Spoiler-guarded.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 4466); it lists PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, Xbox One and PC, and RAWG's own Steam store link for it points to app 893180 ("Catherine Classic"), so that app was used. RAWG keeps "Catherine: Full Body" (2019) as a separate entry. The Steam schema for 893180 is named "Gooseberry" (an internal codename) and its API names are just ACHIEVEMENT_0 to ACHIEVEMENT_49. StrategyWiki has no page under "Catherine", "Catherine Classic" or "Catherine: Full Body". catherine.fandom.com answers the API under "Catherine" with about 54 linked articles (characters, endings, The Mysterious Tale of Rapunzel and Catherine: Full Body); names only were looked at, nothing copied. 21 of 50 Steam achievements are hidden. Where they go is our own guess from schema order and unlock rates: the eight after "Conquer Stage 1" (58.7% down to 20.7%) are treated as later stages; the next eight (1.7% to 9.3%) as endings, since a visible one asks for all endings; three hidden ones listed right after "Obelisk Conquered!" go with Babel, and two after the Rapunzel stage 64 achievement go with Rapunzel.
